strings.name: Francis Ford Coppola
strings.summary: Coppola studied theatre and film and entered Hollywood through low-budget production. The Godfather films, The Conversation and Apocalypse Now explore family, power and war, establishing his New Hollywood role. With Lucas he co-founded American Zoetrope for independent production and technical experiments. He continued taking substantial financial risks on ambitious projects, releasing Megalopolis in 2024.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Shaped American New Hollywood through The Godfather series and Apocalypse Now, while exploring independent production and digital cinema.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Theatre BA, Hofstra; film MFA, UCLA (1966).
strings.highlights.h1.title: The Godfather and New Hollywood
strings.highlights.h1.text: Used family crime narratives to examine power and reshape American commercial cinema.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Independent production
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded American Zoetrope to support filmmakers and technical experiments.
strings.timeline.t9.title: On-set reporting libel suit
strings.timeline.t9.text: The appeals court ordered dismissal of his libel claim over reporting on kissing extras; this did not decide criminal liability.
strings.timeline.t1.title: AFI Life Achievement Award
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received the career honour at a Los Angeles gala.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Megalopolis released
strings.timeline.t2.text: The largely self-financed science-fiction fable competed at Cannes.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Apocalypse Now
strings.timeline.t3.text: The Vietnam War film won Cannes’ Palme d’Or.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Two major films
strings.timeline.t4.text: The Godfather Part II and The Conversation released; the latter won the Palme d’Or.
strings.timeline.t5.title: The Godfather
strings.timeline.t5.text: Directed Mario Puzo’s novel adaptation, which won Best Picture.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founded American Zoetrope
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established an independent film company with George Lucas.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed film MFA
strings.timeline.t7.text: Submitted You’re a Big Boy Now as his UCLA thesis film.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Detroit
strings.timeline.t8.text: Grew up around music and theatre before turning to film.
